page.overview:
Who is Victor Falco?

Dr. Victor Falco, later known as The Rat King, was a sleazy scientist who used his knowledge and talents for his own selfish gain. He appears as a character in the Amazing Adventures comics.

This version of Victor Falco is branched off from in the 2012 TV series. His history before the events of Amazing Adventures is the same as that of his animated version.

Victor Falco appears only as a hallucination after they are affected by Jonathan Crane’s Fear Gas.
